args.title: Bellwether Office: Retail Returns Logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Bellwether Office, "Retail returns logistics"): this week's topic is retail returns logistics, linking to the article at blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and a companion piece at insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion.
- Article: apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Companion piece: resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.
